title: Model-Lab Condition-Contrast Design Gate v1
description: Machine-readable criteria gate that defines what a future Model-Lab Run-004 condition-contrast design must satisfy. v1 describes exactly one honest state: a fully defined criteria gate (gate_status=criteria_defined). It is a design-criteria gate only: criteria_defined allows only the start of a separate Run-004 design task; no primary intervention axis and no concrete condition is selected, no run is executed, no result assessment is allowed, the series is not comparison-ready, and weak_condition_contrast is not resolved. The fixed v1 permissions (run_004_design_allowed=true; run_004_execution_allowed / result_assessment_allowed_after_gate / comparison_ready_after_gate=false; blocker_status_after_gate=open; decision.status=criteria_defined; decision.next_step=run_004_design_may_begin) and the fixed contrast policy (exactly one required primary intervention axis, selected only in run_004_design, with materiality evidence required) are pinned here as const so they cannot drift. Semantic validation (scripts/docmeta/validate_model_lab_condition_contrast_design_gate.py) additionally requires the foundational sources to be safe, regular, readable YAML mappings: exactly one next_blocker_triage (recommending this gate for the open target_blocker) and exactly one result_assessment_readiness gate that remains blocked, both for this series (and challenge_version for readiness); the target_blocker must stay open in both; the invariant / controlled-secondary / materiality id sets must be complete with unique ids; the confounder controls must be complete with their declared effects; and the static baseline non-claims plus the dynamically derived <target_blocker>_resolved non-claim must be present.

gate_status.$comment: v1 models exactly one honest state: criteria_defined. A real blocked state would need its own data model (blocking_reasons, an incomplete criteria set, a permitted repair step, and a transition to criteria_defined) and is intentionally out of scope for v1.

target_blocker.$comment: Semantically this must be the blocker the triage recommends this gate for and that stays open in both the triage and the readiness gate (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_TRIAGE_RECOMMENDATION / CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_OPEN_TARGET_BLOCKER). The expected value (weak_condition_contrast) is read from the source artifacts, not hardcoded into the form.

blocker_status_after_gate.$comment: The gate never closes its target blocker: defining criteria is not resolving the blocker.

run_004_design_allowed.$comment: criteria_defined allows starting a separate design task. Allowing a design is not allowing a run.

run_004_execution_allowed.$comment: A design-criteria gate never authorizes execution.

result_assessment_allowed_after_gate.$comment: Defining contrast criteria does not authorize a result assessment.

comparison_ready_after_gate.$comment: Defining contrast criteria does not make the series comparison-ready.

source_evidence.$comment: Semantically: exactly one next_blocker_triage and exactly one readiness_gate are required (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_TRIAGE_SOURCE / CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_READINESS_SOURCE), both for this gate's own series_id, and both must be safe, regular, readable YAML mappings (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_READABLE_FOUNDATIONAL_SOURCES). assessment_context and method_context are non-foundational: only their existence as safe regular files is checked, never their prose.

invariant_dimensions.$comment: Outcome surfaces a future design must keep fixed. The validator requires the mandatory ids (challenge_contract, acceptance_surface, evaluation_criteria, verification_surface, evidence_capture) to all be present (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CRITERIA).

controlled_secondary_dimensions.$comment: The validator requires the mandatory ids (model_identity_and_version, tool_and_agent_mode, sampling_configuration, human_intervention, dependency_and_runtime_environment, test_harness) to all be present (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CRITERIA).

materiality_criteria.$comment: The validator requires the mandatory ids (single_primary_intervention_axis, operationally_verifiable_difference, no_cosmetic_relabeling, fixed_outcome_surface, provenance_before_execution); non-empty evidence_required on every criterion is enforced structurally by the schema.

confounder_controls.$comment: The validator requires the mandatory ids, each carrying its declared effect_if_uncontrolled (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CONFOUNDER_CONTROLS). The effects describe future reactions to a confounder, not a confounder that has already occurred.

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. The validator requires the static baseline non-claims (run_004_execution_allowed, run_004_executed, result_assessment_allowed, comparison_ready, model_quality, comparative_superiority, condition_effect, external_model_independence, external_auditor_comparison_completed, security_readiness, production_readiness, dependency_risk_remediated) and additionally <target_blocker>_resolved, derived from this artifact's target_blocker (source-derived from triage/readiness).

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Rejected here as form errors: C0 control characters (U+0000-U+001F, incl. NUL/tab/CR/LF), DEL (U+007F), lone UTF-16 surrogates (U+D800-U+DFFF), empty, whitespace-only, leading/trailing whitespace, absolute POSIX paths, Windows drive letters, and backslashes. Parent-escape ('..'), symlink-out-of-repo, and filesystem resolution remain semantic resolver concerns. This is not a general Unicode/Bidi naming policy.

kind.$comment: Provenance label. next_blocker_triage and readiness_gate are foundational (cross-checked and required to be readable YAML mappings); assessment_context and method_context are context-only (existence + safe regular file).

contrastPolicy.$comment: The single-primary-axis contrast policy is fixed in v1: exactly one primary intervention axis, selected only during run_004_design, with materiality evidence required.

materialityCriterion.$comment: evidence_required is structurally mandatory and non-empty: missing or empty materiality evidence is a schema error, not a semantic special case.
